fields.description: Graph node id this row tracks (spec/graph-ir.md Node.id).
fields.label: Node ID

fields.description: Per-node state, independent of every other step -- this is the frontier: many rows may be Ready/Running at once (T-30 bounded-parallel scheduler reads/writes this), unlike Flow Run's single current_node_id (GT-02).
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Ready
Running
Completed
Failed
Skipped

fields.description: node_id of the foreach/parallel node whose body/branch this step belongs to, if any. Null for main-chain steps.
fields.label: Parent Step

fields.description: Human-legible operation identity, e.g. '<procedure>:<node>:<target>'. Not run-scoped (D5) -- companion to idempotency_key, never used for dedup matching itself.
fields.label: Operation Key

fields.description: Content-derived dedup key (D5): sha256(procedure version + procedure name + normalised inputs + target document identity). Not run-scoped -- the same key across two different Agent Procedure Runs is what proves cross-run idempotency, not just retry-within-a-run safety.
fields.label: Idempotency Key

fields.description: Declared in the graph (node.config.recovery), never inferred at runtime (GOAL.md 2.3): retry / resume / abort / compensate. Only set for write-classified tool.call steps.
fields.label: Recovery Mode
